edges.description: Testing procedures for PVC insulated cables are mandated by IS 10810.
Heavy duty cable physical and electrical tests follow IS 10810.
XLPE insulation and armor testing per IS 10810.
Part 2 extends XLPE cable specs for medium/high voltage applications (3.3kV-33kV).
Wiring installation code IS 732 mandates IS 694 compliant PVC cables.
Wiring compliance requires earthing system installed per IS 3043.
Insulating mats provide personnel safety in switchboard areas under IS 732.
Concrete structural design per IS 456 mandates mix proportioning guidelines from IS 10262.
Reinforced concrete design relies on TMT deformed bars conforming to IS 1786.
Concrete mix requires natural coarse and fine aggregates meeting IS 383 specifications.
Accepts 43 Grade OPC meeting IS 8112 requirements.
Accepts 53 Grade high-strength OPC meeting IS 12269.
Permits Fly Ash PPC under IS 1489 Part 1 for durable eco-friendly structures.
Steel construction code IS 800 requires hot rolled structural steel meeting IS 2062.
IS 3589 covers larger diameter (>= 168mm) water mains extending beyond IS 1239 ranges.
HDPE piping alternative to steel water mains under municipal distribution networks.
Solar pumping system arrays require silicon PV modules qualified under IS 14286.
Performance monitoring applies to solar plants constructed with IS 14286 modules.
Fire hazard code IS 2190 mandates portable fire extinguishers manufactured under IS 15683.
Industrial site personal protective equipment combination (Safety Helmet + Safety Shoes).
